content: A vector $$\vec{a}$$ is parallel to the line of intersection of the plane determined by the vectors $$\hat{i}, \hat{i}+\hat{j}$$ and the plane determined by the vectors $$\hat{i}-\hat{j}, \hat{i}+\hat{k}$$. The obtuse angle between $$\vec{a}$$ and the vector $$\vec{b}=\hat{i}-2 \hat{j}+2 \hat{k}$$ is :
